capabilityOperation.description:
Narrow operations: no caller/plugin/namespace, raw paths, SQL, argv or env.
File handles and tool locks must be issued by a future Host adapter.
capabilityOperation.title: CapabilityOperation

DependencyPlanRequest.description: Roots only: package inventory, identities and target are Host-owned.

oneOf.description: Discard overdue occurrences outside the explicit lateness grace.

Return only the latest due occurrence, even outside the grace.

Scope.description: Exact, Host-approved scopes; there are no wildcard grants.

DependencyEdge.description:
Service edges form the provider DAG. Tool pins are leaves, retaining the exact
consumer and artifact separately without activating any plugin provider.

DependencyLock.description:
Value pins, never grants, executable paths, installation or activation receipts.
The digest binds every other field and excludes the digest field itself.

reverseDependencies.description: Direct service consumers, including providers without consumers.

topology.description: Providers before consumers; deterministic identity order breaks ties.
